validator: (args, out) => { const [n, need] = args; let possible = true; { const indeg = new Array(n).fill(0); const adj = Array.from({ length: n }, () => []); for (const [a, b] of need) { adj[a].push(b); indeg[b]++; } const q = []; for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) if (!indeg[i]) q.push(i); let seen = 0; while (q.length) { const u = q.pop(); seen++; for (const v of adj[u]) if (!--indeg[v]) q.push(v); } possible = seen === n; } if (!possible) return (Array.isArray(out) && out.length === 0) || "there is a cycle, so return []"; if (!Array.isArray(out) || out.length !== n || new Set(out).size !== n || out.some((x) => !(x >= 0 && x < n))) return "return each module exactly once"; const pos = new Map(out.map((m, i) => [m, i])); for (const [a, b] of need) if (pos.get(a) > pos.get(b)) return `module ${a} must come before ${b}`; return true; }
